title: Understanding the Roles of the President and Vice President
seoTitle: Roles of Brazil's President and VP
subtitle: Understand the duties defining national leadership and support
excerpt: As Brazil prepares for the polls, citizens will democratically choose the leaders of the Executive Branch at both federal and state levels.
author: Daniele Morais
contentHtml:
Brazil is preparing to go to the polls, once again choosing through democratic means those who will hold the highest offices in the Executive Branch—at both the federal and state levels. The country's future will be shaped by every citizen's vote.

With information from Agência Brasil.
